versions.content: The Dcm shall wait the Full Communication mode indication from the ComM (call to Dcm_ComM_FullComModeEntered ) before initiating the trans- mission of the diagnostic answer. The time to wait should be no longer than the P2ServerMax calculated from the moment the request was received.
